physical_runtime: Complete OpenVINO 2026.1 native NPU runtime, including IR frontend and NPU plugin; manifest in stream-report.json.
observations: DWM created the device, shaders and textures without a recorded UMD rejection, but no draw reached the NPU.
DXGI Present(TEST) returned DXGI_STATUS_OCCLUDED (0x087a0001) 31 times. Both indirect swapchains were created and immediately abandoned without a consumer.
The topology probe saw Default input desktop, no screen saver and two active paths; these checks did not establish visible display content.
A subsequent QEMU screenshot was blank; a keyboard Control press restored the desktop. This motivates an awake-state controlled retry, not a proven cause for all missing frames.
Explorer separately retried an unsupported shader-resource buffer allocation 498 times; this remains a real unsupported path.
cleanup: Both custom devices and packages removed successfully without guest restart; physical host drivers unchanged.
next_trial: Same signed renderer and IDD packages, with visible awake VM before installation and bounded periodic QEMU keyboard Control press/release recorded separately.
